summary: Calibration pass on the 40 records counted as in effect that stood at medium confidence. A research pass tried to open, on an official or research-institution host, the document that keeps each record below high; two independent reviewers then set the text and the number from what was opened, under the fixed rubric (high only when the stage-deciding document was read on a qualifying host; third-party copies and facts known only from news or an unopened retrieval capped at 79). Result: 8 records rose to high (c00-01, c05-16, c06-10, c11-17, c11-18, c12-13, c14-08, c24-03), 20 rose within medium, 11 were unchanged in number after new official corroboration was added, and 1 fell (c14-59, where a Ryan White notice issued 2025-10-02 conflicts with the record's first-notice date and the 2021 HRSA gender affirming care letter remains posted without a rescission notice; its implemented stage was reviewed the same day and changed to in_progress 50 with a partial match, because the operative funding terms sit beside the recommendation rather than withdrawing the 2021 guidance; in-effect count 115 to 114). 68 source entries were added, all read by the research pass; the court-status text of c05-30 was updated from the Supreme Court docket for application No. 26A500 (fully briefed 2026-10-23, undecided), and the court statuses of c12-13 and c16-06 now rest on documents read on the Georgetown Law Litigation Tracker and the Civil Rights Litigation Clearinghouse. No stage or progress changed. Counts unchanged at 627.
